facts.text: InSight Hexagonal Lander was deployed at Elysium Planitia during InSight in 2018.

A high-stability hexagonal deck constructed of aluminum honeycomb with carbon composite face sheets, supported by three landing legs. It carried UHF and X-band communications, avionics, and the RISE geodetic rotation antennas.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the Martian environment.
RISE radio science antennas tracked the wobble of Mars's rotational axis to sub-centimetre precision, proving that the planet's core is liquid and molten.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Elysium Planitia.
Operated quietly for over 1,445 sols, enduring severe regional dust storms before transmitting its final farewell signal in December 2022.
